_readme: One entry per bot run that must start at a precise ET time. at_et = the time the bot is SUPPOSED to fire (America/New_York, 24h). Run `npm run check` after editing.

jobs.fallback_message: IBS pre-open reminder did not start. Open state.json in the repo for today's pending orders; queue them before 9:30 ET.
0DTE condor entry did not start. The window is ~9:31-9:40 ET; if you miss it, skip today (a late entry was never backtested).
Options scanner did not start. It has no intraday timing edge, so run it by hand from the Actions tab whenever you see this.

jobs._note: OPTIONAL. Only if your condor bot polls profit-take/stop levels on a GitHub cron. Those polls drift exactly like the open alerts do. Enable and point at the polling workflow.
